mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.*, NVL(NVL(JIKJE6, NVL(JIKJE5, NVL(JIKJE4, NVL(JIKJE3, NVL(JIKJE2, NVL(JIKJE1, '')))))), '00000000') AS JIKJE, NVL(JJTXT6, NVL(JJTXT5, NVL(JJTXT4, NVL(JJTXT3, NVL(JJTXT2, NVL(JJTXT1, '')))))) AS JJTXT, (SELECT AUTH_CD FROM (SELECT AUTH_CD FROM COMM.USER_AUTH_V@HPOSS_LINK WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND SYS_CD = 'MPPS' ORDER BY AUTH_CD ASC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS AUTH_CD FROM COMM.USER_INFO_V@HPOSS_LINK A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND A.DUP_FLAG = '0'
SELECT DISTINCT PWPL_CFY , DECODE(PWPL_CFY, 1, '수력', 2, '양수', 3, '원자력') AS PWPL_CFY_NM FROM GE_MP_PWPL_C ORDER BY PWPL_CFY
SELECT DISTINCT DIVS_CD AS PPCD, DIVS_NM AS PWPL_NM FROM GE_MP_PWPL_C WHERE PWPL_CFY = 3
SELECT PPCD AS HOGI_CODE, PWPL_NM AS HOGI_NAME FROM GE_MP_PWPL_C WHERE PPCD LIKE ''||#{DIVS_CD}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_MSGE_S ( TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_CFY, RELTN_SCTN_NM, MSG_CTT, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_CFY}, #{RELTN_SCTN_NM}, #{MSG_CTT}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO GE_MP_USE_S ( PPCD, TYPE_CD, RG_SCCD, HOLD_SCCD, DOC_UNQ_ID, SYS_ACSS_CFY_CD, RMK, REGPR_IP_ADDR, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{PPCD}, #{TYPE_CD}, #{RG_SCCD}, #{HOLD_SCCD}, #{DOC_UNQ_ID}, #{SYS_ACSS_CFY_CD}, #{RMK}, #{REGPR_IP_ADDR}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO GE_MP_ECAP_S ( TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, NOTN_DCR, NOTN_CTT, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{DIVS_CD}, #{PPCD}, #{NOTN_DCR}, #{NOTN_CTT}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL||'' AS FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, ATCT_NM, RRD_CFY FROM GE_MP_PRCDOC_M WHERE DLT_YN = 'N' AND AUCR_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_RFCJOB_S ( PWPL_PUCD, PLN_SCCD, PLN_SCTN_NM, WRK_SCCD, WRK_SCTN_NM, WRK_SRVLNC_ID, WRK_SPRVS_FNM, WRKOR_TYP_CD, WRKOR_NO, FNCLC_ID, WRK_NM, BSC_STRT_DY, BSC_STRT_TM, BSC_END_DY, BSC_END_TM, PJB_TYPE_NM, PJB_TYPE_CD, PJB_TM, PJB_PLC_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{PWPL_PUCD}, #{PLN_SCCD}, #{PLN_SCTN_NM}, #{WRK_SCCD}, #{WRK_SCTN_NM}, #{WRK_SRVLNC_ID}, #{WRK_SPRVS_FNM}, #{WRKOR_TYP_CD}, #{WRKOR_NO}, #{FNCLC_ID}, #{WRK_NM}, #{BSC_STRT_DY}, #{BSC_STRT_TM}, #{BSC_END_DY}, #{BSC_END_TM}, #{PJB_TYPE_NM}, #{PJB_TYPE_CD}, #{PJB_TM}, #{PJB_PLC_NM}, SYSDATE )
